integrity: The new claim is the global sharp three-agent impossibility boundary; an existing four-agent example supplies sharpness. Literature comparison and exact auxiliary computations are documented; no independent audit or external mathematical certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: No claim of asymptotic convergence, of rates, or of aperiodic recurrence exclusion; source four-agent witness is credited to its original authors. A related heterogeneous model admits three-agent cycles and lies outside the theorem.
scientific_scope: Homogeneous synchronous self-confident equal-weight SCOD, no externally stubborn agents, arbitrary dimension; exclusion of labeled finite periodic orbits for at most three agents, sharp planar four-agent witness.
title: Four agents are the sharp oscillation threshold for star-shaped confidence sets
